items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Then we made this picture, a short picture with Ina Mae McKinney. The name of it was Pie-Pie Blackbirds.

ctx.x: I went... In the period after the theatre, he went to Baltimore and played a theatre, and Washington and Philadelphia, and then come on back. Then we made this picture, a short picture with Ina Mae McKinney. The name of it was Pie-Pie Blackbirds. I guess we were supposed to be the blackbirds. We was down there in this pie with these hats on, like a chef (?) pie with white hats and the white coats. We was down there. And Ina Mae McKinney, she was singing, you know... But then, that was it.
Was this one of Lew Leslie's Blackbirds acts that were...?
